citation.title: Effect of coherent edge-localized mode on transition to high-performance hybrid scenarios in KSTAR
citation.authors: Youngho Lee, S.K. Kim, J.W. Kim, B. Kim, M.S. Park, J.M. Kwon, M.J. Choi, et al., Yong-Su Na

topic: Offline physics analysis of the coherent edge-localized mode (CEM) and its link to pedestal broadening and performance in KSTAR hybrid discharges from 2020-2021 campaigns, using BES, ECEI, Mirnov, CES and Thomson diagnostics.
own_question: Why do hybrid discharges with nominally identical operational settings reach different performance, and what role does the inter-ELM CEM play?
actual_method_and_evidence: Comparative shot analysis, kinetic-EFIT equilibria, NUBEAM, power balance, MISHKA, EPED and GKW linear runs. BES and ECEI fluctuation amplitudes localize the CEM near the pedestal top. Edge CES Ti recovery slows after CEM onset in one shot. All processing is retrospective. Edge CES time resolution is limited, and NBI was switched off for CES measurements.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: In some KSTAR hybrid discharges, inter-ELM edge fluctuations seen in BES and ECEI coincided with altered pedestal-top CES ion-temperature recovery. This supports physical plausibility that edge-fluctuation signals carry information related to pedestal Ti evolution.
claim_checks.qualification: Shot-level correlation only, from 2020-2021 campaigns, not KSTAR2022. The source reports no CES-report nowcasting or predictive skill. Its CES Ti is a carbon-impurity measurement, as assumed in the source context; main-ion equivalence is unverified.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Pedestal Ti width and height in KSTAR can change between ELM cycles depending on edge MHD activity, motivating inter-report temporal variation beyond hold.
claim_checks.qualification: Pedestal fits come from sparse CES data with tanh fitting. This is the source authors' interpretation, not a demonstrated mechanism.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: The source notes that Thomson resolution is inadequate for tracking the pedestal over ELM cycles. CES report arrival or latency is not given. BES and ECEI are used as full-rate spectral fluctuation amplitudes, not 10 ms voltage snapshots.
validation_if_relevant: Not applicable. There is no predictive model, data split or held-out evaluation.
forbidden_inferences: Do not claim that BES or ECEI predicts CES temperature.
Do not claim that the CEM mechanism applies to our KSTAR2022 chord.
Do not treat CES Ti as main-ion truth.
Do not claim that real-time CES exists or is needed based on this source.
Do not use this source to judge whether prior work is causal.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Include as supporting background on the physical coupling between edge fluctuations and pedestal Ti in KSTAR. It provides no estimator or validation precedent.
